enemies.name: Amber Ram
enemies.description: Locks a route and braces its front while warning, then charges.
enemies.tell: Pale front arc halves incoming primary damage during the 0.65 s warning; orange marks the charge route.
enemies.dodge: Flank or wait: side/rear, charge and recovery take full damage. Warning and recovery remain contact-safe.

enemies.name: Violet Spitter
enemies.description: Maintains 230 px distance and fires aimed projectiles.
enemies.tell: Orange ring marks its 0.65 s firing preparation.
enemies.dodge: Strafe after its aim locks; pink bullets can be dodged.

enemies.name: Knifeleg Flanker
enemies.description: Weaves sideways while approaching rather than taking a direct line.
enemies.tell: Alternating lateral path; no ranged attack.
enemies.dodge: Avoid retreating into its side path.

enemies.name: Moss Broodkeeper
enemies.description: Alternates a hollow ground pulse first, then its existing summon. At most 3 living children.
enemies.tell: Pulse: two orange edges mark a fixed 70–180 px band for 1.0 s. Summon: the old small ring for 0.65 s.
enemies.dodge: Enter the inner pocket or leave the outer circle; both orange edges hurt. Other enemies still hit. Leave its body before recovery ends.

enemies.name: Scrap Warden
enemies.description: Wave 3 boss: alternates a locked charge and targeted ground blast. Below half HP it moves and attacks faster.
enemies.tell: 0.85 s line or ground circle. Warning/recovery have no contact damage.
enemies.dodge: Dodge sideways from line; leave the marked circle before detonation.

enemies.name: Spore Reactor
enemies.description: Wave 6 boss: maintains distance and fires ring volleys. Below half HP, 12-shot rings alternate with summons.
enemies.tell: 0.85 s orange ring before each release.
enemies.dodge: Use gaps in the slow ring; dash is briefly invulnerable. Clear summons.

enemies.name: Stitch Drone
enemies.description: Channels a 10 HP repair to one wounded ordinary ally within 150 px. Cannot repair bosses, summons or support drones.
enemies.tell: Cyan dashed tether and four-notch progress mark a 1.2 s repair; any actual damage to the drone interrupts it.
enemies.dodge: Hit the drone, finish its ally or separate them beyond the tether. It has no damage immunity. Warning and recovery are contact-safe.
